name: preflight_step
description: Preflight profile: 6 Mbps for 30 s, 1.5 Mbps for 30 s, 6 Mbps for 30 s (run with --duration 90). Each step leaves 20 s after the 10 s settle for pf-delivery-rate; the last step checks that delivery recovers to the link rate after the restore (the post-restore stall seen in fresh-grid-v2).
